TOPIC 8.12 
Volume with Washer 
Method: Revolving 
Around Other Axes

LEARNING OBJECTIVE

CHA-5.C
Calculate volumes of solids 
of revolution using definite 
integrals.

ESSENTIAL KNOWLEDGE

CHA-5.C.4
Volumes of solids of revolution around any 
horizontal or vertical line whose cross sections 
are ring shaped may be found using definite 
integrals with the washer method.

ENDURING UNDERSTANDING

CHA-5
Definite integrals allow us to solve problems involving the accumulation of change in 
area or volume over an interval. 

SUGGESTED SKILLS 

Connecting 
Representations

2.D
Identify how mathematical 
characteristics or properties of 
functions are related in different 
representations.
